intro: Today's tech landscape is defined by significant regulatory shifts and major product developments from Apple. We are also seeing important progress in research utilizing advanced AI models to address complex scientific problems.

must_know.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
must_know.summary: Following a scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, US lawmakers are pushing for stricter export controls on AI chips to China and have requested testimony from company leadership.
must_know.why_it_matters: Rising geopolitical tensions and security concerns are accelerating regulatory efforts to restrict the flow of critical AI hardware.

must_know.title: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health
must_know.summary: Apple has launched the Apple Health AI Usage Study, a 200,000-person project designed to evaluate how consumers use and interact with conversational AI for health-related queries.
must_know.why_it_matters: This study underscores Apple's increasing focus on validating the safety and clinical utility of health-focused AI tools.

must_know.title: Apple’s first smart glasses are coming together
must_know.summary: Apple is reportedly planning to announce its first pair of non-AR smart glasses at WWDC next June, with shipments expected to begin by the end of that year.
must_know.why_it_matters: This marks a key step in Apple's wearable hardware strategy as it expands beyond mobile and VR/AR headsets.

research.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
research.summary: OpenAI researchers have proposed a nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model, utilizing assistance from GPT-6 Astra to formalize the proof.
research.why_it_matters: The use of advanced models to aid in complex theoretical physics proofs highlights a new role for AI in scientific discovery.
